subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped third-party Action update after controlled evidence that the updated app-token and Codex-agent workflows still operate correctly with their existing secrets and write permissions?
rationale: The patch changes code executed in privileged workflows; the correct trust threshold and availability of a safe credentialed run are repository-owner decisions, not something Dependabot or a read-only reviewer can establish.

options.title: Validate protected workflow paths
options.body: Run the affected app-token and Codex-agent paths on the current head and attach redacted successful logs before merging.

options.title: Accept reviewed upstream pins
options.body: A workflow/security owner may accept the pinned revisions after independently reviewing the upstream action changes and their credential scopes.

recommendation.title: Validate protected workflow paths
recommendation.body: Run the affected app-token and Codex-agent paths on the current head and attach redacted successful logs before merging.
